panel.headline: Your property services, in one trusted place.
panel.body: Manage requests, visitors and community updates with role-based access.
panel.footnote: Protected by encrypted sessions and automatic timeout.

login.title: Sign in to CivicKey
login.subtitle: Use the phone number registered with your property.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
errors.inactive: This account is inactive. Contact property support.
errors.roleMismatch: This account is not registered as {{role}}. Select the correct role and try again.
errors.validation: Check your phone number and password, then try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.network: Can't reach CivicKey. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

session.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

shell.comingSoon: This section is not available yet.

denied.title: You don’t have access to this area
denied.description: Your {{role}} role cannot open this page. Return to an allowed area, or contact your society administrator if you think this is a mistake.

myFlat.intro: The flat the society office has assigned to you.
myFlat.ceasedNote: This assignment has ended, so it no longer gives you access to the flat. Ask the society office to register you again.
myFlat.waiting: The society office has not verified this registration yet. You get access once it is approved.
myFlat.viewOnly: You have view-only access, so you can see the flat but not approve visitors or pay bills.

empty.title: No flat assigned yet
empty.description: The society office assigns your flat. Contact them if you think this is wrong.

validatePass.label: Validate pass
validatePass.description: Scan QR or enter pass ID

noSociety.title: No society yet
noSociety.description: Your account is not linked to a society. Contact your administrator.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Kept in the audit trail with your name. At least 3 characters.

details.title: Society details
details.description: The society as it is registered, and how residents and guards reach the office.
details.name: Society name
details.gstinHint: Only if the society charges GST on maintenance.

structure.title: Blocks, floors and flats
structure.description: The whole hierarchy, with what is sold and who lives there.
structure.noFlats: No flats on this floor yet.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.addDescription: Every floor belongs to a block, so the first block comes before anything else.
blocks.name: Block name

empty.title: No blocks yet
empty.description: Add the first block to start building the society structure.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this block?
deactivate.description: Block {{name}} stops being available for new floors and flats. Nothing already recorded is deleted.

floors.title: Floors in this block
floors.addDescription: Choose the block first; a floor always belongs to one block.
floors.label: Floor label
floors.labelHint: Free text: B2, Ground, 1st Floor, Terrace.
floors.orderHint: Optional. Negative values sort basements first.
floors.chooseFirstDescription: Pick a block above to see and manage its floors.

empty.title: No floors in this block
empty.description: Add a floor before adding flats to it.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this floor?
deactivate.description: {{label}} stops being available for new flats. Nothing already recorded is deleted.

flats.title: Flats on this floor
flats.addDescription: Choose the block and then one of its floors. Only floors of the chosen block are listed.
flats.chooseFirstDescription: A flat belongs to a floor, so pick the block and floor above first.
flats.maxOccupantsHint: Tenants only; owners never take a slot.

empty.title: No flats on this floor
empty.description: Add the first flat to this floor.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this flat?
deactivate.description: Flat {{number}} stops being available for new residents. Nothing already recorded is deleted.

flats.carpetAreaHint: Used to work out the maintenance charge.
flats.parkingHint: Separate the slots with commas; the count is worked out from them.
flats.intercomHint: Guards call this to confirm a visitor.

residents.title: Residents and tenants
residents.description: Owners and tenants of this society, current and past.
residents.searchPlaceholder: Name, mobile, flat or flat id
residents.searchHint: Try a resident name, a mobile number, 101, A-101, or paste a flat id.
residents.flatDescription: Everyone registered to this flat, current and past.
residents.rejectDescription: {{name}} is not given access to the flat. The reason is kept in the audit trail.
residents.closeDescription: {{name}} loses access to the flat from today. A new registration is needed to bring them back.

empty.title: No residents match
empty.description: Change the filters, or register a resident from the Flats tab.

register.title: Register a resident for flat {{number}}
register.description: Creates the account if the mobile number is new. The registration waits for verification before it gives access.
register.name: Full name
register.accessHint: View only is for children and other family members.
register.endDateHint: Access ends automatically on this date.
register.idLast4Hint: Never the full number; only the last 4 characters are stored.
register.proofHint: Sale deed or rent agreement reference.

gates.title: Gates
gates.description: Guards are posted to a gate. Every entry and exit records which gate it happened at.
gates.name: Gate name

empty.title: No gates yet
empty.description: Add the gates people use, so a guard can be posted to one.

deactivate.title: Close this gate?
deactivate.description: {{name}} stops being available for new postings. Entries already recorded keep it.

addUser.intro: Creates the account and the flat registration. The admin never sets or sees a password.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role decides which dashboard this person gets. Owner and tenant are chosen below, under the flat.

RESIDENT.label: Resident
RESIDENT.description: Owner or tenant of a flat

notYet.title: {{role}} accounts are not created here yet
notYet.GUARD: Guards are added under Staff management, which has no API yet. This form only creates residents.
notYet.ADMIN: An Admin account is created by another Admin, and a committee member is a resident given committee permissions. Neither has an endpoint yet.

personal.title: Personal details
personal.languageHint: Used for notices sent to this person.

signIn.title: Sign-in and contact
signIn.description: The mobile number is the sign-in ID.
signIn.phoneHint: 10 digits. Must not already belong to another society.
signIn.emailHint: Optional. Can also be used to sign in.

flat.title: Flat and household
flat.description: Links the person to a flat. Residents only see their own flat.

identity.title: Identity verification
identity.description: Used by the society to verify who lives at the premises.
identity.aadhaar: Never type the full Aadhaar number. Only the document type and its last 4 characters are kept, and the number itself never reaches the database.
identity.consent: The person agreed to share this ID for society verification, and was told why it is collected and who can see it.

emergency.title: Emergency contact
emergency.description: Who the society calls if something happens to this person.
emergency.name: Name

onSave.title: What happens on save
onSave.account: The account is created if the mobile number is new, and the resident role is assigned.
onSave.pending: The registration starts pending. It gives no access until an Admin verifies it under Approvals.
onSave.audit: The action is recorded in the audit log with your name.

notStored.title: Not collected yet
notStored.description: On the printed form but with nowhere to store it, so these are left out rather than silently dropped:
notStored.documents: ID copies, rental agreement and police verification
notStored.invite: The SMS invite and OTP, so a resident cannot sign in until that ticket lands

addUser.noFlats: There are no flats yet. Add a block, a floor and a flat under Society & users first.

staff.intro: Guards need Manage guards. Daily help and staff passes need Register staff.
staff.listDescription: Search by name or mobile number.
staff.name: Full name
staff.noGates: Add a gate under Society & users first.
staff.photoHint: Where the photo is filed. Uploads are not stored yet.
staff.flatsServedHint: The flat’s residents see this person under Daily help and are told when they enter or leave.
staff.passToHint: Leave empty for no end date.
staff.consent: The staff member agreed to share their photo and ID for gate verification.
staff.saved: {{name}} saved, and the staff pass issued.

addDescription.GUARD: Guards are posted to a gate on a shift, and scan passes at that gate.
addDescription.DAILY_HELP: Maids, cooks, drivers and others who work for one or more flats. Each gets a staff pass the guard scans at the gate.
addDescription.VENDOR: Plumbers, electricians and other service staff working for the society.

empty.title: Nobody here yet
empty.description: Add the first person with the button above.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this staff member?
deactivate.description: {{name}}’s pass stops working at the gate. Nothing already recorded is deleted.

billing.intro: Each panel appears only to admins who hold the permission shown under its title.

rates.title: Maintenance rates

bases.PER_SQFT: Per sq ft of carpet area

rates.dueDayHint: Between 1 and 28, so every month has the day.
rates.effectiveFromHint: Old rates stay on bills already generated.

payment.title: Record a cash payment
payment.paidByPlaceholder: Name of the person who paid
payment.receiptNote: A receipt number is created automatically and the resident sees it in their app. A cash entry cannot be deleted, only reversed, and both are recorded in the audit log.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: What has been billed, what has been paid, and the receipts behind each one.
invoices.noReceipts: Nothing received against this invoice yet.
invoices.reverseDescription: Receipt {{receipt}} stays on the record, and the amount goes back on the invoice.

empty.title: Nothing billed yet
empty.description: Generate the first month’s invoices above.

reports.intro: Read back from the invoices and assignments themselves; nothing here is cached.
reports.title: Reports

empty.title: Nothing to report
empty.description: There is no data for this report and period yet.

security.intro: Who did what, newest first. The trail is written by the server and cannot be edited.
security.title: Security activity

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.description: Activity shows up here as people use the society’s account.

sync.empty: Nothing recorded on this device yet.
sync.liveNote: Entries saved offline reach residents only after they sync. A resident has not been asked or told until then.
